group_manifest.proof_strategy: Handle the six CircularAreaIsFull witnesses in manual order. Unfold store_circular_area to expose the representation and instantiate its six hidden witnesses for the entry entailment; fold it back after returns. For result 0 with distinct indices, use circular_area_distinct_indices_imply_nonfull__is_full_contract and unfold CircularAreaFullResult. For equal indices, destruct the status and the two equal-index iff clauses of CircularAreaLogicalState to prove the empty/status-zero and full/status-nonzero results. Null and string-offset goals close after unfolding their result definitions or integer normalization. Spatial postconditions reuse exactly the descriptor fields, GlobalStrings, and UCharArray.mixed_full resources from P.

group_entry.proof_strategy: Handle the six CircularAreaIsFull witnesses in manual order. Unfold store_circular_area to expose the representation and instantiate its six hidden witnesses for the entry entailment; fold it back after returns. For result 0 with distinct indices, use circular_area_distinct_indices_imply_nonfull__is_full_contract and unfold CircularAreaFullResult. For equal indices, destruct the status and the two equal-index iff clauses of CircularAreaLogicalState to prove the empty/status-zero and full/status-nonzero results. Null and string-offset goals close after unfolding their result definitions or integer normalization. Spatial postconditions reuse exactly the descriptor fields, GlobalStrings, and UCharArray.mixed_full resources from P.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaIsFull_entail_wit_1: select one proposition disjunct; unfold store_circular_area; instantiate operations/readidx/writeidx/b_status/physical/data_buffer; rewrite circular_area_pre=area_addr and cancel the unchanged resource
per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaIsFull_return_wit_1: select one proposition disjunct; obtain Zlength contents < capacity from distinct indices using the existing helper; unfold CircularAreaFullResult; reconstruct store_circular_area
per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaIsFull_return_wit_2: select one proposition disjunct; equal indices plus b_status=0 and the invariant's empty iff give length=0; capacity positivity makes length distinct from capacity; result is 0; fold the resource
per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaIsFull_return_wit_3: select one proposition disjunct; invariant status range turns b_status<>0 into b_status=1; equal-index/full iff gives length=capacity; result is 1; fold the resource
per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaIsFull_return_wit_4: select the GlobalStrings branch or emp branch; unfold CircularAreaErrorResult and close circular_area=0 and result=1 by hypotheses/reflexivity
per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaIsFull_partial_solv: select one proposition disjunct and normalize 0*sizeof(CHAR); the demanded literal-address equality is reflexive

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Either opaque store_circular_area at entry or the fully exposed descriptor fields, GlobalStrings, and UCharArray.mixed_full at returns; null branches carry GlobalStrings or emp.
vc_shape.pre_pure: Root non-null/equality facts, CircularAreaLogicalState, and branch guards readidx<>writeidx or readidx=writeidx with b_status=0/nonzero.
vc_shape.post_spatial: The same representation folded as store_circular_area, or unchanged GlobalStrings/emp.
vc_shape.post_pure: CircularAreaFullResult 0/1, CircularAreaErrorResult 1, or a zero-offset string-address identity.
vc_shape.post_exists: Entry entailment chooses exactly the witnesses hidden by store_circular_area.

witness_instantiation.representation_open: Reuse the existential operations, readidx, writeidx, b_status, physical, and data_buffer obtained by unfolding store_circular_area.
witness_instantiation.return_fold: Use the concrete representation values already quantified by each return VC.

group_entry.space_plan: Unfold/fold store_circular_area and cancel syntactically identical descriptor, string, and mixed-array resources; no array split or ownership transfer is needed.
group_entry.pure_plan: Use the equal-index/full and equal-index/empty iff clauses, status range, capacity positivity, and logical-length bounds from CircularAreaLogicalState; normalize the result predicates and the literal pointer arithmetic.
group_entry.refinement_plan: none; all six are direct separation-logic/pure obligations

premise_discharge.representation: store_circular_area definition or the explicit field resources in P
premise_discharge.empty_equal_indices: readidx=writeidx, b_status=0, and the invariant empty iff
premise_discharge.full_equal_indices: readidx=writeidx, b_status<>0, invariant status range, and the invariant full iff
premise_discharge.null_and_literal: precondition equalities plus unfolding and integer normalization

group_entry.grouping_reason: These six witnesses belong to the same loop-free helper function and share one representation-open/fold pattern plus one CircularAreaLogicalState result family. Keeping them together preserves that context, while splitting from the seven data-length witnesses is required because all 13 targets cannot form one group under max_witnesses_per_group=12.
